title: I'm looking for honest feedback on this new concept that I think AI will take over in a few months
author: Excellent_Delay1660
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m working on a project and put together this short video to see if people would be willing to hop on the website: [miniworlds.co](http://miniworlds.co) and give some feedback.

I’d love to hear your honest first impressions of an **episodic interactive series using AI.** The goal is you can almost interact with all of the characters, Talk with them and change the timeline.  
  
  
Does it look interesting? What catches your attention, and what feels confusing or could be improved?

It’s still a work in progress, so I’m mainly trying to understand what resonates with people and what needs more work. Critical feedback is welcome!

Thanks for taking a look!

comments.author: Excellent_Delay1660
comments.body: Curious to think what people think of episodic games, and where that will go as well! [miniworlds.co](http://miniworlds.co) is the right link.

replies.author: greentrillion
replies.body: Episodic games already exist, like Genshin Impact and they are very popular.

replies.author: Excellent_Delay1660
replies.body: hey would you be down if I interview you for a coffee? I would love to learn about what aspects you like about genshin impact etc and how you think that experience can be better

replies.author: greentrillion
replies.body: So you just reply with your bot on reddit then and get people to interact with your bot? To what end?

replies.author: DT-2004
replies.body: Would you say it was about the graphics itself or gameplay?

replies.author: Kindly-Sail6260
replies.body: He definitely means both. The guy put out a very janky looking game with very obvious bugs. But I assume this is the norm.

replies.author: DT-2004
replies.body: Appreciate the feedback, I’ll work on improving the gameplay before putting it out next time!

replies.author: Kindly-Sail6260
replies.body:
Yes please do! It’s not to say you didn’t do anything wrong, but people will look at this and view it as low effort content built with AI. If you have the time, ask Claude, or chat, or whatever open llm you can toss questions to about what makes great games according to actual and successful game developers. Right now you’re excited about this stuff and that’s great, but it’s time to think like a game developer. Granted, your first full game will always be the worst one in comparison to whatever you decide to create later, but after a game or two, you’ll really start to lock in and see games from a different point of view. 

My favorite thing about game development right now is playing an actual game made from actual studios and established indie devs and I’m literally picking apart and guessing as to what they do to achieve the game they created. That is how you should approach your mindset in my opinion. 

Now go forth and continue creating!

replies.author: DT-2004
replies.body: You’re extremely sweet for taking the time to write it, thanks again!

comments.author: ProbablyDoesntLikeU
comments.body: That graphics could use some more polish

replies.author: DT-2004
replies.body: 100% trying to balance interactivity with graphics on a broswer, any particular things you’d suggest?

replies.author: ProbablyDoesntLikeU
replies.body:
Browser graphics can still have textures and more intricate design. I'd reccomend creating an asset library using opus, you could have it do some passes on the current assets. My favorite method is using something like meshy on generated images. I'm able to run a version of it locally, but I have to do it part by part and stitch the model together,  because my local 2d to 3d model can't run the whole image at once properly. 

What models and what harness are you using? How much of the process is done by you vs by ai?

comments.author: Hot-Middle7260
comments.body: What do you mean using AI? In a sense that you're building it with AI help? or the characters themsleves have the capability to respond to me alike LLM, like ChatGPT or Claude agents?

replies.author: DT-2004
replies.body: Both, characters have the ability to speak and chat with you. The romance island game should have it along with the fatass game
